the intention to download mobile game applications is explained by the presence of price value, game quality, positive emotions, and gender and gameplay time, in different ways.

price value, game quality, positive emotions, gender and time spent playing games combine to lead to a high intention to download.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mobile game developers should focus on creating a high price-value perception for their games, as well as a high quality content, which would lead to positive emotions, especially for female users.

mobile games are complex and that the intention to download them is not only a function of the game content quality and positive emotions, but of the interactions of these with price value, gender and gameplay.
the combination of price value, game quality, positive emotions and gameplay time, leads to high intention to adopt mobile games, with gender being a moderating factor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the intention to adopt mobile games is not a matter of one factor, but of the complex interplay of multiple factors.
the intention to adopt a mobile application is the result of multiple configurations, which are not necessarily the same for all users.
there is no one best way for a mobile application to succeed.
